name: PINTAR
summary: Digital learning platform for KEMENAG serving 1.3 million+ participants nationwide.
problem: KEMENAG needed a centralized web-based training platform to deliver e-learning content to thousands of ministry employees across Indonesia, replacing fragmented offline training.
solution: Architected a concurrent training platform with video streaming, course management, and progress tracking. Built modular course delivery system that handled peak load during mandatory training cycles.
impact: Served 1.3 million+ participants, exceeding national targets. Replaced offline training workflows with on-demand digital learning.

name: Pusaka Super Apps
summary: Cross-platform super-app for KEMENAG consolidating internal services into one mobile experience.
problem: KEMENAG staff juggled 10+ separate internal tools (HR, document management, approvals) across web and mobile, causing friction and low adoption.
solution: Unified everything into a single React Native super-app backed by Django REST API and Laravel microservices. Next.js admin dashboard for content ops.
impact: 1M+ downloads, 256K national employees using attendance system. Replaced 10+ legacy internal tools with single mobile app for all ministry staff workflows.

name: Waste Management System
summary: Real-time waste tracking platform for KEMENKES healthcare facilities.
problem: Healthcare facilities under KEMENKES lacked visibility into medical waste lifecycle — from generation to final disposal — creating compliance and safety risks.
solution: Built a tracking system with field mobile app (React Native) for waste logging at source, web dashboard (Next.js + Node.js) for monitoring, and real-time alerts for non-compliant facilities.
impact: End-to-end traceability for medical waste. Real-time compliance monitoring across multiple facilities.

name: BIB KEMENAG
summary: Scholarship management platform — Beasiswa Indonesia Bangkit (KEMENAG + LPDP partnership).
problem: Managing scholarship applications across KEMENAG and LPDP required coordinating between two ministries, thousands of applicants, and multi-stage review workflows.
solution: Built a centralized scholarship platform handling application submission, multi-stage review, document verification, and award notification. Integration with both ministry systems.
impact: 195K+ users. Streamlined end-to-end scholarship lifecycle. Centralized review workflow replacing email-based coordination.

name: Learn Prompting ID
summary: Prompt engineering learning platform in Bahasa Indonesia — fundamentals, token optimization, and ready-to-use templates.
problem: Quality prompt engineering resources in Bahasa Indonesia were scarce. Most learners relied on English-only tutorials, missing context for local use cases.
solution: Built and shipped a structured learning platform covering context-instruction-format-constraints framework, token optimization techniques, and chain-of-thought workflows. Curated copy-paste templates for common use cases.
impact: Self-published curriculum in Bahasa Indonesia. Ready-made templates users can drop into their own AI workflows immediately.
